overview.description: The MicroSectors Energy 3X Inverse Leveraged ETNs (WTID) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Solactive MicroSectors Energy index. The fund is an exchange-traded note that tracks 300% inverse of the daily price movements of an index of US-listed energy and oil companies, selected and weighted by liquidity. WTID was launched on Feb 17, 2023 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
